# claude-proxy

Run **Claude Code** with a different model behind it.

You keep the Claude Code CLI exactly as it is â same interface, tools, skills, permissions â but
inference goes to a model of your choice through a localhost-only
[CLIProxyAPI](https://github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI) server, using a provider account you
already pay for.

![Claude Code running on gpt-5.6-luna](docs/claude-code-luna.png)

```
claudex  âââº  Claude Code CLI  âââº  127.0.0.1:8317  âââº  your provider account
             (unmodified)          (CLIProxyAPI)        Codex Â· Gemini Â· xAI Â· Kimi Â· any OpenAI-compatible

claude   âââº  Claude Code CLI  âââº  api.anthropic.com
```

- Your normal `claude` command is untouched â both live side by side
- Add as many commands as you want, one per model, all sharing one proxy
- Nothing is exported globally; each command sets its own environment for that invocation only
- Claude Code itself is never patched or wrapped

## Getting started

Open a fresh Claude Code session and hand it [`setup-prompt.md`](setup-prompt.md).

The agent takes it from there: it checks what you already have, asks which model you want and what to
name the command, works out the model's real context window on its own, installs and configures the
proxy, walks you through the browser login, and verifies the whole path end to end.

Then use it like Claude Code, because it is Claude Code:

```bash
claudex
claudex --continue
claudex --effort low -p "explain this file"
```

Want to add a second model later, rename a command, or point one somewhere else? Hand the agent the
same file â it detects the existing setup and asks what you want to change.

## Requirements

macOS or Linux with zsh (Windows via WSL) Â· [Claude Code CLI](https://claude.com/claude-code) Â·
a subscription or API key for the model you want to route to

## Limitation

**CLI only â this does not work in the Claude Desktop app.** Desktop pins its own model and API
endpoint when it launches Claude Code and ignores project environment settings, so requests never
reach the proxy.
